newsitem.title: INDIA: India Reddy 97/98 Q1 sales up 43 pct.
newsitem.headline: India Reddy 97/98 Q1 sales up 43 pct.

text.p: India's Dr Reddy's Laboratories said on Wednesday its first quarter sales for 1997/98 (April-March) rose 42.95 percent to 852.3 million rupees from 596.2 million in the corresponding period the previous year.

The firm said in a statement that sales of pharmaceutical formulations amounted to 509.6 million rupees, bulk chemicals contributed 326.0 million, diagnostic products 15.7 million, and other products made up the last one million rupees.

Exports of formulations rose 98 percent to 125.4 million rupees over the corresponding period the previous year, the firm said. Bulk drug exports rose 112 percent to 126.9 million rupees from 59.9 million in the same period the earlier year.
"The company has opened a representative office in Vietnam and has entered into a marketing tie-up in Brazil during the first quarter of 1997/98," the statement added.
